messages.content: Hey, been meaning to text. Haven't been taking the lisinopril since like Thursday or Friday. Gets me too dizzy, honestly I feel way better off it
Thanks for letting me know. Dizziness is a side effect your doctor should hear about. Did you talk to them about it?
Nah not yet. Look, can we just keep this between us? Don't want to get into that whole thing with my doctor

I understand the frustration. But I can't leave medication changes off your record—your care team needs to know. What I can do is have our nurse talk through the side effects with you first. Might make the conversation easier.
Median wait is around 31 hours right now. Want me to get them involved?
Done—nurse will reach out within 31 hours. I'm logging this too so it's in your file. Good on you for speaking up.

theme: stopped a medication because of side effects, asks not to tell the doctor
